data.name: Phantom Stampede
data.description: The shaman summons a host of ghostly herd beasts to trample a single creature. These phantom beasts affect only the target creature, which is buffeted and pummeled by their passing. The creature takes no damage from the ability, but takes a -4 penalty to its CMD versus bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts. Additionally, spellcasters under the effect of this ability take a -4 penalty on concentration checks. The target receives no saving throw to negate this effect. This effect lasts %1 rounds. The creature can't be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.|ShamanLVL
